title: chelidonium majus subsp. laciniatum
intro: Chelidonium majus subsp. laciniatum, commonly known as the Cut-leaf greater celandine, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the poppy family (Papaveraceae). It is a perennial herb that has been used for centuries in traditional medicine, particularly in Europe, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Chelidonium majus subsp. laciniatum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antitumor properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions, such as digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, including berberine, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
